limitations: Two scenarios, one new isolated Case and at most two new fixed-scope Runs. Original A/I reused; old Runs never redispatched.
B01 is the no-H baseline. H01 is a new fixed Run on that Case after the original material-review text; new accepted C3 feeds C6.
Synthetic materials and assistant-authored material review, not independent ground truth or business authorization.
H, designated historical result and query time differ between scenarios; no controlled A/B or accuracy claim.
Existing per-Run limits and bounded correction only. Known repeated prose-quality issues remain NOT_PASSED; no sampling to chase success.
Knowledge forward held for each complete Run. No model deployment, migration, HTTP contract change, consumer or streaming update.

expectation: H原文/版本/范围/附件在输入和引用中保持。
